text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day during the holidays, Symboli Rudolf asks me to come to the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass, look! They brought out more cakes!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Really, Spe, that's your fourth one. I think you've had enough already…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But look at the name! It's called Premium Matcha Cake! It looks sooo good!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Premium… Matcha…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well, I suppose we could take a look…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yay! Ehehe, it really is the most wonderful time of the year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The cafeteria is crowded with Umamusume. As I try to make my way through…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! There you are. Welcome to the student council holiday party.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Naturally. We do this every year. Public events are an excellent way of raising student morale.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And logistical justifications aside, it would be a bit of a shame not to celebrate the holidays in some way, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Attendance is voluntary, and students are free to come and go as they please. We usually see participation rates of around fifty percent…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But this year, attendance has exceeded ninety percent. Which is to say, nearly the entire student body is present.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As one of the organizers, I can't deny it's flattering, but at the same time, we didn't plan for this many attendees.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The entire student council is running itself ragged trying to cater to them all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I hate to invite you here only to abandon you, but it seems you may have to enjoy the party on your own.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I planned to show you around myself, but I doubt I'll have the chance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My apologies. But at the very least, I'm confident that you'll enjoy the festivities.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, if that's all…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, President! I'm sorry to interrupt, but…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: We… we wanted to ask, um… Could you take a picture with us?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: A photo? Of course.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Thank you! You're the best!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: We're so sorry for interrupting you, Trainer, but we thought this might be our only chance!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: The President looked so at ease when she was talking with you…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I am an open book, it seems. My dignity is in shambles…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I mustn't let the camera capture my embarrassment. Speaking of which…
choice_data_list: Want me to take the photo?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If you would be so kind. Do try to get our best sides.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wait! Um… President, could you stand in the middle? With your arms crossed?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If you wish, but… why?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: You need to really look like the Emperor! I want to capture you at your coolest!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Very well. If that's what you want…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then how about this?

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek! That's so awesome!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have other poses too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaa! Sh-she's so… imperial!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha… I think I could get used to this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This holiday party turns out to be a fun opportunity to see Rudolf cut loose a little.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Good grief. I knew I was right to seek you out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You've been working since this morning. You must be exhausted. Why don't you get some fresh air?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Surely the same goes for you? You had just as early a start as I did.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I took a break earlier in the afternoon, as per your imperial decree. Or have you forgotten?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well… I suppose that's true, but…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No buts. I've already told the rest of the student council that you're indisposed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It would only cause confusion if I were to change the story now. Are you certain that's wise?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Is it just me, or have you gotten less compromising recently? But very well. You've made it clear I have no choice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, Trainer, it seems I can either leave of my own volition or be chased out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And seeing as I would prefer to leave with my dignity intact… would you come with me for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Look, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We can see the entire academy from up here. Of course, this late in the day, it's all dark…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Except for the lights of the cafeteria. It's beautiful, don't you think? The way it shines in the darkness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Every student of Tracen Academy is their own glimmer of light, and when they come together, they are radiant indeed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It's my place to do everything I can to help them shine brighter.
choice_data_list: And it's my job to help you shine brighter.
And it's my job to help you shine brighter.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oho?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, aren't you confident. I hope you can live up to those words.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That aside…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Do I hear music in the air? That must be the start of the dance.
choice_data_list: Are you sure? I don't hear anything.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We Umamusume have better hearing than humans, so that's only to be expected.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I really don't hear anything… but if she says so, then it must be true.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, we won't make it back before this song ends. In which case…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What do you say we have our own dance right here?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Nervous, are you? Don't underestimate your dance partner.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The Emperor will take the lead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Unless you're getting cold feet?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I am pleased to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, then. May I have this dance?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grip…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now turn here, and… Oho? You're rather good at this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha. I may have found myself the perfect dance partner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us enjoy our private holiday ball for a while, until Symboli Rudolf has finally danced her fill.
